name: BEANZ GameCube System Monitor
author: BEANZ
description_short: Lightweight GameCube system and connected-device diagnostic utility.
description_long: Displays runtime, memory, video, and timing information on original GameCube hardware. The devices page reports controller and memory card connections and response-based SP1/SP2 occupancy. Supports hotplug detection and START to return to Swiss. Tested on DOL-001 hardware using SD Gecko and SD2SP2. SP1 occupied detection remains unverified.
